name: Tempting Fate
source:
A ragtag group of unlikely friends thrown into myths and legends, prompted by an ancient prophecy foretelling mass destruction.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一群乌合之众，由一群不太可能的朋友组成，在一个预言大规模毁灭的古老预言的推动下，他们陷入了神话和传说中。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
